name: paper-finder-student-mcp
description: Search scholarly papers, find open access copies and related work through OpenAlex (https://openalex.org), a free open catalog of more than 250 million works. Free and open source, with no key needed.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search scholarly papers by keywords, with optional year and open access filters.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Details for one paper from a DOI, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id, including the abstract.

tools.name: get_paper_by_doi
tools.description: Details for one paper looked up by DOI only, with a helpful error for anything that is not a DOI.

tools.name: find_open_access_pdf
tools.description: The free to read copy of one paper, preferring a PDF link, or a plain note that none exists.

tools.name: related_papers
tools.description: Papers OpenAlex marks as related to a paper.

tools.name: get_related_work
tools.description: The same list as related_papers, under a verb-first name.

tools.name: cited_by
tools.description: Newer papers that cite a paper, most recent first.

tools.name: list_author_papers
tools.description: Papers by one author, most cited first, matched by the name as written on the papers.
